content.text:
**Status** — `github app` + `bullfrog` + `Codex/Claude proxy`:

**1. GitHub App: NOT configured (PAT only)**
```toml
# ~/.preloop/config.toml
[github]
mint_failure = "pat"
pat = "gho_72h7..."  # PAT, no app_id/app_pem
```
`~/.local/bin/preloop doctor`: `github app: not configured`
`~/.local/bin/preloop status`: jobs get PAT as `GITHUB_TOKEN` → no Checks API (local-only check-runs).

Fix — creates App via manifest (loopback redirect, no key leaves machine):
```sh
~/.local/bin/preloop setup github --via app
# webhooks off by default (localhost unreachable) — outbound still works:
#  checkout/gh/GITHUB_TOKEN, `preloop run` triggers
# add webhooks later when you have public URL:
~/.local/bin/preloop setup github --via app --public-url https://<stable-tunnel-host>
# or: cloudflared tunnel --url http://127.0.0.1:9090 run 16cc97ea-e9d5-4723-875a-6de90f880b07
#     then preloop setup github --via app --public-url https://preloop.preloop.dev
```
Verify: `preloop doctor --repo preloopdev/preloop`

**2. Bullfrog (`bullfrogsec/bullfrog`): already supports custom URL — no fork needed**
- Cloned `/tmp/bullfrog` — `action.yml:33-36` exposes:
  ```yaml
  _control-plane-api-base-url: default: "https://api.bullfrogsec.com/"
  _control-plane-webapp-base-url: default: "https://app.bullfrogsec.com/"
  ```
  `action/src/inputs.ts:79-82` does `core.getInput("_control-plane-*")` + `formatUrlWithTrailingSlash()`. Tested in `action/src/__tests__/inputs.test.ts`.
- Use in preloop workflow (GHES-compatible, works with `PRELOOP_GITHUB_SERVER_URL`):
  ```yaml
  - uses: bullfrogsec/bullfrog@v0.10.0
    with:
      egress-policy: block
      allowed-domains: |
        api.github.com
        *.docker.io
      _control-plane-api-base-url: https://api.bullfrogsec.com/ # point to fork if self-hosting control plane
  ```
- Limitations: `ubuntu-*` only, no `container:` jobs, requires `sudo`/`nftables`/`libnetfilter-queue-dev`. Preloop smolvm is Ubuntu ARM64 — `installPackages()` will `apt-get install` on first run; verify golden has `nft` or install per-job.

**3. Codex/Claude subscriptions (CLIProxyAPI): already wired, currently down**
- `~/.codex/config.toml` already points to proxy:
  ```toml
  model_provider = "openai"
  wire_api = "responses"
  base_url = "https://cliproxy.bnjoroge.com/v1"
  api_key = "sk-cliproxy-5fwbp26..."
  ```
- `~/.cli-proxy-api/` has 3 auths: `codex-e852a960...json` (Team, `chat@bnjoroge.com`), `claude-hi@bnjoroge.com.json`, `antigravity-...json`
- Local API `http://127.0.0.1:8317` (`/opt/homebrew/etc/cliproxyapi.conf: host 127.0.0.1 port 8317`) was **stopped** (`brew services list: none`). Started manually → `GET /v1/models` 200, but token refresh fails:
  - `openai_auth.go:322 401 invalid_refresh_token` (Codex `rt.1.AABno...` expired 2026-07-02)
  - `anthropic_auth.go:480 400 invalid_grant` (Claude `sk-ant-ort01...` expired 2026-06-23)
- `https://cliproxy.bnjoroge.com/v1/models` → `1033` — no `cloudflared --url http://127.0.0.1:8317` running (only tunnels to 8765/9095/8787/8788/8080/8083/8181/5080).
  Fix:
  ```sh
  /opt/homebrew/bin/CLIProxyAPI -config /opt/homebrew/etc/cliproxyapi.conf &
  cloudflared tunnel --url http://127.0.0.1:8317  # → keep stable hostname cliproxy.bnjoroge.com
  # then re-login expired creds:
  CLIProxyAPI -codex-login
  CLIProxyAPI -claude-login
  # or: codex login + claude login if using native OAuth
  ```

Proceed with `preloop setup github --via app` now? (needs browser, `127.0.0.1` callback). Or want me to fork `bullfrogsec/bullfrog` to `preloopdev/bullfrog` and republish action with GHES-aware docs first?

content.text:
Yes — **GHES** is exactly the patch.

`preloop` is a GHES-compatible control plane: jobs get `GITHUB_API_URL`/`GITHUB_SERVER_URL` pointing at `127.0.0.1:9090` (or `https://aksh.preloop.dev`), not `api.github.com`/`github.com`. `pullfrog` hardcodes both — `fetch("https://api.github.com...")`, `https://github.com/...git`, `Octokit` without `baseUrl` — so it blackholes against preloop.

**Fork pushed:** `Bnjoroge1/pullfrog@ghes-url-support` — `https://github.com/Bnjoroge1/pullfrog/tree/ghes-url-support` — `09dde42` (branch `ghes-url-support`):

- `utils/github.ts`: `githubRequest` → `GITHUB_API_URL`, `createOctokit({ baseUrl: GITHUB_API_URL })`
- `commands/init.ts`: `ghApi` → `GITHUB_API_URL`, App URLs → `GITHUB_SERVER_URL`
- `utils/apiCommit.ts`, `utils/install.ts`: release API → `GITHUB_API_URL`
- `utils/setup.ts`, `mcp/git.ts|xrepo.ts|checkout.ts`: `clone`/`remote`/`pushUrl` → `GITHUB_SERVER_URL` (host via `new URL(serverUrl).host`, SSH `git@host:repo`)
- `utils/gitAuthServer.ts`, `assets.ts`, `buildPullfrogFooter.ts`, `statusChecks.ts`, `modelAccess.ts`, `apiKeys.ts`: all `api.github.com`/`github.com` → env

`tsc --noEmit` clean, `pnpm test`: 742 passed, 1 unrelated fixture missing.

**OpenAI-compatible (your Codex/Claude via CLIProxy):** no code change — pullfrog `openai-compatible/byok` already reads `OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_BASE_URL/_API_KEY/_MODEL/_CONTEXT/_MAX_OUTPUT` (`utils/apiKeys.ts:274` validates 5 required). Left CLIProxy alone as requested.

**Preloop workflow:** `.github/workflows/pullfrog.yml` (local, not yet pushed per `preloop-submit-before-push`):
```yaml
uses: Bnjoroge1/pullfrog@ghes-url-support
with: { prompt: ${{ inputs.prompt }} }
env: { OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_BASE_URL, _API_KEY, _MODEL=gpt-5.6-terra, _CONTEXT=128000, _MAX_OUTPUT=16384 }
```
Submitted: `preloop run -f .github/workflows/pullfrog.yml --event workflow_dispatch` → `38e399c6-d56f-4407-b725-11ae5f7b6ca6` `in_progress` in `~/.preloop/state/preloop.db`.

Next: `gh pr create --draft` for the workflow after you confirm, or test with `GITHUB_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9090` smoke.
You should set the server as the, as actually not local. Cause I wanted to run in CI. So instead of running in hosted actions, it would run in my environment. So do that.

name: Pullfrog (GHES-compatible fork)

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      prompt:
        description: 'Prompt for the agent'
        required: false
        default: 'List the files in this repo and summarize the README in one paragraph.'
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write
  issues: write
  id-token: write

jobs:
  pullfrog:
    runs-on: self-hosted
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Run Pullfrog (via GHES-compatible fork)
        uses: Bnjoroge1/pullfrog@ghes-url-support
        with:
          prompt: ${{ inputs.prompt }}
        env:
          OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_BASE_URL: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_BASE_URL }}
          OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_API_KEY }}
          OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_MODEL: gpt-5.6-terra
          OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_CONTEXT: "128000"
          OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_MAX_OUTPUT: "16384"
